meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按仓库既有的提交风格和语言,把一批改动拆成多个独立的小提交,并先给出风格检测结果和提交计划;也能做 rebase/squash 和翻查历史。
howto.when: 当你提到 “commit”“rebase” 等关键词,或想回溯、整理历史时触发;它会先判断当前是提交、变基还是查历史的模式。

say.text: 把这些改动提交,按仓库风格拆成多个原子提交
say.note: 会先检测提交风格并输出提交计划

say.text: 把这三个提交 squash 成一个
say.note: 进入 rebase 模式重写历史

say.text: 找出是谁在哪次提交里加了这行代码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude splits your changes into several small independent commits, matching the repo's existing commit style and language, and prints a style check plus commit plan first. It also does rebase/squash and history lookup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "commit", "rebase" and similar keywords, or ask to trace or clean up history; it first decides between commit, rebase, or history-search mode.

say_en.text: Commit these changes, split into atomic commits in the repo's style
say_en.note: It first detects style and prints a commit plan

say_en.text: Squash these three commits into one
say_en.note: Enters rebase mode to rewrite history

say_en.text: Find who added this line and in which commit
